minigame.reward.callHome: The whole crew talked to their families: spirits go up!
minigame.bike.title: Exercise bike
minigame.bike.help: Press ← and → one after the other to pedal. Keep the needle in the green band.
minigame.bike.fact: Without gravity, muscles and bones get weaker because they don't have to hold the body up. On the Space Station astronauts exercise about 2 hours a day.
minigame.scrubber.title: CO2 scrubber
minigame.scrubber.help: Move the filter with ← and →. Catch the CO2 (gray with two red) and let the oxygen (two red) go by.
minigame.scrubber.fact: Every time you breathe out, you release carbon dioxide (CO2). In a closed ship it would build up and cause headaches: the scrubber traps it and leaves the oxygen to breathe.
minigame.water.title: Water recycler
minigame.water.help: Pick a pipe with the arrows and turn it with E. Bring the used water through the filter to the clean tank.
minigame.water.fact: On the Space Station almost all water is recycled: 98 out of every 100 glasses, even sweat and pee! It is filtered until it is cleaner than a lot of tap water.
minigame.radio.title: Call home
minigame.radio.help: Turn the dial with ← and → until the wave is clean, and follow it for a little while.
minigame.radio.fact: Radio travels at the speed of light, but Mars is so far away that a message can take up to 22 minutes. Today your voice takes {delay} to reach Earth.
minigame.stars.title: Navigate by the stars
minigame.stars.help: Turn the sky with ← and → until the constellation matches the one on the left. Lock it with E.
minigame.stars.fact: Spacecraft know where they are pointing by looking at stars with a camera called a star tracker: it compares what it sees with a map of the sky, just like you did.
minigame.stars.notYet: It doesn't match yet: keep turning
minigame.pulse.title: Medical check
minigame.pulse.help: Press E right when each heartbeat crosses the line.
minigame.pulse.fact: In space the heart doesn't have to push blood up against gravity, so it works less and gets a little rounder. That's why doctors check astronauts often.
minigame.meal.title: Ship kitchen
minigame.meal.help.menu: Every day there is a different meal for the whole crew: don't forget which one!
minigame.meal.help.recipe: Look closely at the ingredients and their order: you won't have the recipe at the counter. Press E when you know it.
minigame.meal.help.cook: Pick with the arrows and add each ingredient with E, in the recipe book's order. If you forget, leave with Q and read it again.
minigame.meal.fact: On the Space Station astronauts use tortillas instead of bread: they don't make crumbs, and floating crumbs can get into machines or eyes.
minigame.meal.menu.next: What goes in it, and in what order? It's in the recipe book, in the kitchen corner. Read it and come back to the counter.
minigame.meal.recipe.title: Ship recipe book
minigame.meal.notYet: That's in the recipe, but not yet. What came next?
minigame.meal.notInRecipe: This meal doesn't have that. Think of the recipe book.
minigame.meal.prompt.go.menu: Go to the counter to see today's menu
minigame.meal.prompt.go.recipe: Find the recipe in the recipe book in the corner
minigame.meal.prompt.go.cook: Go back to the counter to cook {dish}
minigame.shield.title: Check the shelter
minigame.shield.help: Fill the holes in the wall with water bags: pick with the arrows and press E. First the ones with a particle coming!
minigame.shield.fact: Water stops the particles the Sun throws out in a storm. That is why the shelter walls are full of water: the more water around you, the less radiation reaches your body.
minigame.plants.title: Care for the plants
minigame.plants.help: Pick a plant with the arrows and give it what it needs: 1 water, 2 light, 3 ladybugs.
minigame.plants.fact: Greenhouse plants grow under purple lights: they mostly use red and blue light. And ladybugs eat aphids without any poison.
minigame.plants.needs.dry: Look at the dry soil: it needs water
minigame.moxie.title: MOXIE
minigame.moxie.help: Hold E to heat it up and let go to cool it down. It only makes oxygen in the green band, around 800 °C.
minigame.moxie.fact: MOXIE traveled to Mars on the Perseverance rover and made oxygen from the Martian air, which is almost all CO2. To do it, it heats up to about 800 °C. In total it made 122 grams: what a small dog breathes in 10 hours.
minigame.moxie.hot: Too hot! Let go of E
minigame.seals.title: Clean the seals
minigame.seals.help: Move the brush around the door with ← and → and hold E to clean the dust.
minigame.seals.fact: Mars dust is finer than baby powder and sticks to everything. If it gets into the door seal, air escapes: that is why it has to be cleaned often.
minigame.patch.title: Patch the leak
minigame.patch.help: Move the detector with the arrows: it beeps faster near the leak. Put the patch on with E.
minigame.patch.fact: Micrometeoroids are specks smaller than a grain of rice, but they travel faster than a bullet. Spacecraft have walls with several layers to stop them.
minigame.patch.noLeak: No leak there: watch the detector
minigame.tutorial.title: How to play
minigame.bike.tutorial.1: Press ← and → one after the other to pedal.
minigame.bike.tutorial.2: Keep the needle in the green: not too slow, not too fast.
minigame.bike.tutorial.goal: Pedal steadily until the bar is full.
minigame.scrubber.tutorial.1: Move the filter from side to side.
minigame.scrubber.tutorial.2: Catch the CO2: it's air already breathed.
minigame.scrubber.tutorial.3: Let the oxygen through: the crew breathes it.
minigame.scrubber.tutorial.goal: Catch the CO2 without grabbing the oxygen.
minigame.water.tutorial.1: Pick a pipe with the arrows.
minigame.water.tutorial.3: Lead the used water to the clean tank.
minigame.water.tutorial.goal: Build the water's path through the filter.
minigame.radio.tutorial.2: Find the clean wave, with no noise.
minigame.radio.tutorial.goal: Hold the signal until the call connects.
minigame.stars.tutorial.2: Match it to the constellation on the left.
minigame.stars.tutorial.goal: Find out where the ship is pointing.
minigame.pulse.tutorial.2: Press E right when they touch the line.
minigame.pulse.tutorial.goal: Take the pulse by hitting the beats.
minigame.meal.tutorial.1: At the counter, check today's menu.
minigame.meal.tutorial.2: In the recipe book, read what goes in and in what order.
minigame.meal.tutorial.3: Go back to the counter and add them in order, from memory.
minigame.meal.tutorial.goal: Cook today's meal for the whole crew.
minigame.shield.tutorial.1: Pick a gap and fill it with a water bag.
minigame.shield.tutorial.2: First the ones with a Sun particle on the way.
minigame.shield.tutorial.goal: Fill every gap in the wall.
minigame.plants.tutorial.goal: Pick each plant with the arrows and heal them all.
minigame.moxie.tutorial.1: Hold E to heat; let go to cool down.
minigame.moxie.tutorial.2: In the green band (800 °C) it makes oxygen.
minigame.moxie.tutorial.3: If it gets too hot, it stops.
minigame.moxie.tutorial.goal: Make oxygen at just the right temperature.
minigame.seals.tutorial.1: Move the brush around the door.
minigame.seals.tutorial.2: Hold E to clean the dust.
minigame.seals.tutorial.goal: Leave the seals dust-free so the door closes tight.
minigame.patch.tutorial.1: Move the detector with the arrows.
minigame.patch.tutorial.2: It beeps faster near the leak.
minigame.patch.tutorial.3: Place the patch with E right on the leak.
minigame.patch.tutorial.goal: Find the leak and seal it.
minigame.fuses.title: Change fuses
minigame.fuses.help: Find the blown fuses (black) with the arrows and put in the spare with the same number using 1, 2 or 3.
minigame.fuses.fact: A fuse is a thin wire that burns on purpose when too much current flows: that way it protects everything else. That is why you need the same one, not stronger and not weaker.
minigame.fuses.tooStrong: It is stronger than the board says: it would protect nothing
minigame.fuses.tooWeak: It is weaker: it would blow again right away
minigame.fuses.tutorial.1: Find the blown fuse with the arrows.
minigame.fuses.tutorial.2: Look at the number on the board.
minigame.fuses.tutorial.3: Put in the same spare with 1, 2 or 3.
minigame.wires.title: Splice the cable
minigame.wires.help: For the glowing end on the left, pick the one with the same color on the right with ↑ and ↓ and join them with E.
minigame.wires.fact: A thick cable carries many thin colored wires inside. The colors help you not mix them up when repairing: each one carries something different.
minigame.wires.wrongColor: That one is not the same color
minigame.wires.tutorial.1: Look at the color of the glowing end.
minigame.wires.tutorial.2: Pick the same color with ↑ and ↓.
minigame.wires.tutorial.goal: Join every end: the energy flows again.

minigame.harvest.title: Harvest the greenhouse
minigame.harvest.help: Pick a pot with ← → and cut with E when the marker is in the green band: not unripe, not overripe.
minigame.harvest.fact: Lettuce, radishes and chili peppers have already been harvested on the Space Station. Part of each harvest is saved and sent back to Earth to study how plants grow far from home.
minigame.harvest.cut: Just right! A sprout for the sample
minigame.harvest.unripe: Still unripe: wait for the green band
minigame.harvest.overripe: Too late: wait for it to sprout again
minigame.harvest.tutorial.1: Pick a pot while it grows.
minigame.harvest.tutorial.2: Bright green and in the band: cut!
minigame.harvest.tutorial.goal: Cut each plant when it is just right until the jar is full.
minigame.reward.harvest: Harvest! Fresh food for the base and a plant sample: take it to storage to load it on the ship.
minigame.reward.harvestFood: Harvest! Fresh food for the base. You already have all the plant samples.
minigame.dust.title: Clean the panels
minigame.dust.help: Move with the arrows to each dusty panel and brush it with E. Leave the clean ones alone.
minigame.dust.fact: On Mars, dust settles on solar panels and blocks the sun. The wind saved the Opportunity rover by cleaning its panels several times. InSight was not so lucky: it ran out of power in 2022.
minigame.dust.scratch: That one was clean! Brushing it scratches it
minigame.dust.tutorial.2: Brush with E, once per layer.
minigame.dust.tutorial.3: Do not brush a clean panel: it scratches.
minigame.dust.tutorial.goal: Leave every panel dust-free to get more power.
minigame.night.title: Get ready for the night
minigame.night.help: Pick a switch with ↑ and ↓ and flip it with E. Turn off everything except what has a heart.
minigame.night.fact: On Mars the night drops to 80 degrees below zero and the panels give nothing. The base lives on its battery until sunrise: that is why everything that is not needed gets turned off.
minigame.night.essential: That keeps the crew alive! It stays on
minigame.night.tutorial.2: Turn off with E what is not needed at night.
minigame.night.tutorial.3: Anything with a heart stays on.
minigame.night.tutorial.goal: Leave on only what keeps the crew safe.
minigame.reward.cleanPanels: The panels give full power again!
minigame.reward.nightPrep: Tonight the battery will last longer.

console.mode.science.text: More samples and a happier crew, but more power is used and machines wear out.
console.mode.lifeSupport.name: Life support first

console.mode.ration.name: Ration the food
console.mode.ration.text: Food lasts more days, but a hungry crew is neither happy nor strong.
